'''Fleet Supervisor''' was a position within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] overseeing the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]] assets of a [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. [[Dwin Wisheel]] served as the Fleet Supervisor for the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]]. In that position, Wisheel took possession of a [[VR-10 Cuirilla-Rayl Xylines-class spacetug|VR-10 ''Cuirilla-Rayl Xylines''-class spacetug]] ''[[Worthless Fool]]'' that a young [[procurement officer]] had purchased from [[Yearo Seville]].
